# Q18: exact [[1088,128,16]], check weight 8

This sparse self-adjoint quaternary lifted product uses a 3-by-5 constituent
over F4[C16]. Both physical check matrices have rank 480; the maximum
balanced check weight is 8 and the maximum column weight per sector is 5.
The displayed full regular canonical frame has width 26. Its optimality is
not claimed. The complete constituent, checks and seeds are stored one level
above this proof directory and are reconstructed by the catalogue verifier.

A completed exhaustive search excluded every nontrivial Z logical through
weight 15, over all 68 normalized translation roots. It used
2,428,976 nodes. Independent validation checks the full physical
algebra, every root and frontier entry, the unpartitioned one-shard coverage,
source/input/executable/log hashes, and an attaining weight-16 witness.
A verified block-transpose isometry transfers the lower bound to X. Thus the
distance is exactly 16 in both sectors, not a heuristic upper bound.

Source, normalized receipts/logs, and all physical inputs are supplied. Executable contents are omitted. Recorded absolute paths in receipts are metadata only; the
validator reads package-relative files. Completed execution records are not
formal node-by-node proof traces.

With Python >= 3.10, validate the preserved certificate:

```sh
python3 replay.py
```

For a fresh C++17 replay, use a new output directory:

```sh
python3 replay.py --run --output /path/to/new-directory --seconds 180
```

Replay compiles the portable source and preserves the original evidence. An
unfinished replay exits 75 and establishes no new lower bound.

Public receipts have calendar, job, and workstation metadata removed. File hashes
bind the normalized copies. Executable fingerprints are declarations; compiled
binaries are omitted. Portable replay builds from the supplied source.

# Q16: exact [[1088,128,22]] with optimal canonical width 22

This self-adjoint quaternary lifted-product code over F4[C16] has constituent

```
C = [[1,1,1,1,1], [1,1,2,1,3], [1,3,1,2,1]]
E = [[0,0,0,0,0], [0,6,12,13,1], [0,12,6,9,5]]
```

Here 2 denotes omega and 3 denotes omega squared. Every entry is C_ij t^E_ij.
Both binary CSS matrices have rank 480. The maximum balanced check weight is
10 and the maximum column weight per sector is 6. All eight X and all eight Z
seed operators have weight 22; their complete translated cross-Gram is I128.

All 64 disjoint hash-prefix shards completed exclusion of nontrivial Z logicals
through weight 21, covering all 68 normalized roots in every shard. The search
used 781,613,767 nodes. Its common frontier had 41,047 entries, and the union
of owned entries also had 41,047; the common digest was
`15633900906150424296`. The independently verified sector-transpose isometry
transfers this lower bound to X. Physical weight-22 witnesses attain the bound
in both sectors, so d_X = d_Z = d = 22.

Every canonical logical generator has weight at least the code distance.
The stored full regular canonical frame attains that lower bound. Therefore
both the unrestricted canonical width and the C16-regular canonical width
are exactly 22.

The package supplies source, physical inputs, and metadata-normalized receipts and logs. Executable fingerprints are declared; binaries are omitted.
The validator reconstructs the constituent, check row spaces, ranks, all
translated frame syndromes, complete canonical pairing, sector symmetry and
witnesses, and checks every source/input/log hash and declared executable identity and shard.

Validate the stored complete certificate without rerunning the search:

```sh
python3 replay.py
```

Python >= 3.10 and its standard library are sufficient. For a fresh portable
C++17 replay, choose a new output directory:

```sh
python3 replay.py --run --output /path/to/new-replay-directory
```

The fresh run compiles the included source, uses four workers for the 64
shards, and refuses to overwrite existing evidence. Completed execution
records are not formal node-by-node proof traces. The quick audit validates
their coverage and correspondence to the displayed code.

Public receipts have calendar, job, and workstation metadata removed. File hashes
bind the normalized copies. Executable fingerprints are declarations; compiled
binaries are omitted. Portable replay builds from the supplied source.
